question: A dealer purchased a microwave for ₹57,000. He allows a discount of 64% on its marked price and still gains 38%. Find the marked price of the microwave.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price = 57000

Gain 38% ⇒ Selling Price = 57000 × 1.38 = 78660

Discount = 64% ⇒ SP = 36% of MP

⇒ MP = 78660 ÷ 0.36

**∴ MP = 218500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP = 57000, Gain = 38%, Discount = 64%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + Gain%) and SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 57000 × 1.38 = 78660

⇒ SP = 36% of MP

⇒ 0.36 × MP = 78660

⇒ MP = 78660 ÷ 0.36 = 218500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹218500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + profit/100)

Discount Formula

SP = MP × (1 − discount/100)

Key Insight

Link SP from both profit and discount equations to find MP
